# Enable log capture for debugging complex diagnostics

<small>Source: [`R/utils.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/utils.R) · Help: `?ht_enable_log_capture`</small>

When enabled, log messages are recorded in memory (and optionally mirrored to
a file or connection) for later inspection via [`ht_log_history()`](ht_log_history.md).

## Usage

```r
ht_enable_log_capture(enabled = TRUE, max_entries = 1000L, sink = NULL)
```

## Arguments

`enabled`
:   Logical flag, `TRUE` to enable capture and `FALSE` to disable.

`max_entries`
:   Maximum number of entries to retain in memory. Older
    entries are discarded first. Use `Inf` to keep all entries.

`sink`
:   Optional file path or connection to mirror log output.

## Value

Invisibly returns `NULL`.

## Deprecated

Deprecated since 0.14.0, with [`ht_log_history()`](ht_log_history.md) and
[`ht_clear_log_history()`](ht_clear_log_history.md): of the logging functions only
[`ht_set_log_level()`](ht_set_log_level.md) stays exported after 1.0.0. They still work and warn.
